instruction: Show every source with its date. Do not mark a winner.

sources.title: Clean Electricity Investment Credit (§48E)
sources.date_label: Page does not show a date
sources.statement: The page still describes a phase-out in 2032, or when emissions fall to 25% of the 2022 level, and base rates of 6% and 30%.

sources.title: Clean Electricity Production Credit (§45Y)
sources.date_label: Page does not show a date
sources.statement: The §45Y page is shown beside the §48E page. It is not treated as updating Notice 2025-42 or the vacatur report.

sources.title: IRS Notice 2025-42
sources.statement: Notice 2025-42 says wind and solar facilities placed in service after 2027-12-31 lose the §45Y and §48E credits unless construction began on or before 2026-07-04.

sources.title: Court Restores 5% Safe Harbor for Wind and Solar
sources.statement: The article reports that on 2026-06-06 the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia vacated Notice 2025-42 and restored the 5% safe harbor. The court opinion was not read for this card. This is a secondary report, not a decision about which rule applies.
